goal: External training -> user imports an ONNX model + configuration -> chooses default/per-record model -> runs real CPU inference on original ECG -> stores model-version-specific results separate from DSP and manual review. No in-platform training page and no installed pretend/pretrained model. Respect user's removed disclaimer/footer/methodology UI: do not reintroduce decorative text.

ownership.Main: backend/model_registry.py, backend/server.py API wiring, reporting integration, dependencies, tests/test_model_workflows.py and all validation

manifest_rules: schema_version=1; name1..80,version1..32,description<=1000; task beat_classification|record_classification|record_multilabel; classes2..64 unique nonempty strings<=80 preserving order; sample_rate100..1000 finite; input_samples64..20000 int; lead_names1..12 unique names<=80, ['selected'] allowed only sole lead and resolves current ANALYSIS lead (not view dropdown). pre_samples required int0<pre<input_samples for beats, optional/null for record tasks. normalization none|zscore|minmax per channel/window with epsilon1e-6; input_filter raw|bandpass; notch0|50|60 and must0 if raw; output_type logits|probabilities; threshold finite0<threshold<1 used multilabel. Reject extra configuration keys. Training must use EXACT declared resampling/filtering/window/normalization/class-order contract; import proves runtime compatibility, not predictive accuracy.
source_filter_constraint: When input_filter=bandpass, requested nonzero notch must be below HALF THE ORIGINAL SOURCE sampling rate, not target rate. Incompatible source rates block compatibility and inference rather than silently skipping a declared training preprocessing operation.

engine_exports.validate_model(content:bytes, metadata:d: -> tuple[normalized_manifest:dict,session:onnxruntime.InferenceSession,signature:dict]. ValueError Chinese message for malformed/incompatible. Parse onnx protobuf from bytes; refuse external tensor data recursively incl constants/subgraphs before checker/session, refuse nonstandard domains (allowed '',ai.onnx,ai.onnx.ml), no pickle/Torch checkpoint loading or external file access. onnx checker; ORT CPUExecutionProvider, <=4 intra-op threads. Exactly one tensor(float) input and one float output. Input rank2 [B,N] only1lead or rank3 [B,C,N]; fixed dims must agree manifest, batch dynamic or fixed1 only. Output rank2[B,K], K=classes length. Dry run zeros B1 (B2 also when dynamic) verify finite output and probability contract when configured. Signature {input_name,output_name,input_shape,output_shape,layout:'NL'|'NCL',dynamic_batch:bool,runtime_version,provider:'CPUExecutionProvider'}. No health confidence/accuracy fields.
engine_exports.compatibility(manifest:dict,record:dict): ->tuple[bool,reason:str]. Check has_original, ordered required lead availability; ['selected'] resolves record.selected_lead. Beat tasks require reliable detection and >=1 peak; record tasks require >=input_samples/sample_rate seconds. Return actionable reason, not diagnosis.
engine_exports.predict(session,manifest:dict,signature:: -> result below, no persistence/API. Original {sample_rate,leads:{name:np.ndarray},units:mV}. Use full source arrays only. Resolve ordered channels; optional existing ecg._filter_waveform once per source channel for bandpass; resample_poly per source channel using Fraction(target/source).limit_denominator(10000) (reuse when same fs). Extract beats around actual record.peaks[].index converted by original fs -> target fs, pre_samples before R; complete windows only, skip boundaries WITHOUT padding. Reject unreliable/no valid beat windows. Record tasks analyze one fixed window at nearest target sample to start; reject short/outside rather than pad. Normalize each channel/window exactly. Contiguousfloat32 input, batch<=32 when dynamic and1 otherwise. Run real session.run; validate every batch row/outputK/finiteness, softmax logits for single-label or expit logits for multilabel; probabilities must within0..1 and single-label sum1 within1e-3, never invent/renormalize malformed predictions. Preserve original peak index/time and real source window bounds. output labels/score for single-label are argmax actual scores, labels for multilabel >=threshold; no claim score clinically calibrated.
engine_exports.record_result_note: record task predictions list length1; index:null,time=actual start,start/end exact fixed window. For multilabel class_index:null,class_label=joined selected labels or '未超过阈值',score=max actual scores,scores full ordered list,labels selected labels. counts include all manifest classes incl0. elapsed_ms actual perf_counter. Boundary skipped and configuration/operator errors explicit. Use lightweight private helpers, avoid repeated filters or per-prediction resampling.

storage: Main creates models(id,name,version,metadataJSON,signatureJSON,onnxBLOB,sha256,filename,size_bytes,imported_at) UNIQUE(name,version), settings(default_model_id), model_predictions(id,record_id FK cascade,model_id text WITHOUT FK deletion cascade,created_at,payload compressedJSON). Preserve all current records/notes. Model config immutable; PATCH only name/description. First imported model default automatically; explicit default action; deleting default clears default without silently selecting another. Prediction snapshots preserve manifest/version/SHA even after model deletion. Bound session cache<=2, reuse validated import session. Import limit100MB model +512KB manifest; safe filename stored only, never static model/patient files. Duplicate name/version409.

api.GET /api/models: {models:[flat normalized manifest fields +id,signature,is_default,sha256,filename,size_bytes,imported_at],default_model_id:str|null}; no nested metadata/manifest aliases
api.POST /api/models/import: multipart file (.onnx), config JSON string. Return imported model metadata+signature+is_default; malformed400/422,too large413,duplicate409. config_file optional frontend reads JSON locally and submits config string. Main validates import using engine.
api.PATCH /api/models/{id}: JSON {name?:str<=80,description?:str<=1000}; no config changes; duplicate name/version409
api.DELETE /api/models/{id}: {ok:true,default_model_id:str|null}; cached session evicted; historical prediction audit retained
api.GET /api/models/{id}/manifest: download normalized config JSON only (never contains model weights)
api.GET /api/models/template: download example manifest above. Route before /{id}. Example config only, not a fake trained model.
api.POST /api/records/{id}/predict: JSON {model_id:str,start:float>=0=0}. Request original signal, real ONNX runtime, store result, return prediction below. start used record tasks; beats whole record no arbitrary clipping. ValueError400/422,missing originals409,model/record404. Run off event loop synchronous FastAPI endpoint.
api.GET /api/records/{id}/predictions: query model_id optional; {predictions:[full prediction newest first,limit20]}. Each includes stale bool,stale_reason,model_available bool from current record context. Reanalysis selected_lead/notch/peak-index fingerprint changes makes old result stale; manual reviews/name edits do NOT make stale. New selected model loads its own results, never relabel old scores.
api.report: Existing record report includes latest non-stale prediction by default. Optional ?prediction_id selects exact saved result and checks record ownership; explicitly selected stale results labeled historical. Render actual model/version/classes/scores/preprocessing/window separately from DSP/human review. No model/no valid prediction -> omit. Model deletion preserves snapshot export/report audit. Never invent accuracy.
api.health: version2.1.0; existing api2 /^2/ remains valid. All old endpoints stay functional. Chinese detail strings, existing same-origin mutation checks preserved. Middleware raises request size only on exact /api/models/import, original ECG20MB limit unchanged.
